summary: Comprehensive audit of structural, economic, itemization, and progression gaps identified in Aden Arena.

gapsMatrix.currentState: CRAFTING_RECIPES contains only 13 recipes (mostly boss/spellbook items)
gapsMatrix.externalEvidence: Classic & Essence have exhaustive recipe catalogs for all D/C gear
gapsMatrix.observedGap: 95% of D-Grade and C-Grade equipment cannot be crafted from materials
gapsMatrix.impact: Critical: invalidates dwarf crafting and isolates gathering/mining

gapsMatrix.currentState: RefineryService creates 12 high-grade materials (Steel, Cord, Leather, etc.)
gapsMatrix.externalEvidence: Refined materials are the mandatory inputs for all weapon/armor recipes
gapsMatrix.observedGap: Refined materials accumulate in inventory with almost 0 consumption sinks
gapsMatrix.impact: High: player investment in life activities leads to orphan items

gapsMatrix.currentState: MONSTER_DROPS yields hundreds of complete, finished weapons and armors in common zones
gapsMatrix.externalEvidence: Monsters primarily drop raw materials and patterns; whole gear is ultra-rare (<0.1%)
gapsMatrix.observedGap: Common monsters bypass the crafting system by handing out finished products
gapsMatrix.impact: Critical: devalues crafting, floods inventory, inflates vendor sell gold

gapsMatrix.currentState: Obsolete low-grade gear is liquidated via sellAllJunk for minor Adena
gapsMatrix.externalEvidence: Collections system permanently burns gear in exchange for account-wide stats
gapsMatrix.observedGap: Lack of a sacrificial sink to absorb obsolete No-Grade and D-Grade gear
gapsMatrix.impact: High: accelerates currency inflation and devalues low-grade gear

gapsMatrix.currentState: Uniform 1 shot consumed per attack/cast regardless of weapon or target count
gapsMatrix.externalEvidence: Bows consume 2-4 shots; AoE spells consume x1 to x3 shots based on mob count
gapsMatrix.observedGap: Ranged and AoE classes operate at identical resource cost to melee classes
gapsMatrix.impact: High: distorts class balance and operational sustainability

gapsMatrix.currentState: Grinding generates gold, exp, and drops; no passive crafting charge exists
gapsMatrix.externalEvidence: Common Craft gauge fills on mob kills, enabling autonomous scroll crafting
gapsMatrix.observedGap: Grinding sessions do not generate enhancement scrolls autonomously
gapsMatrix.impact: Medium: F2P and idle progression stalls at safe enchant thresholds

gapsMatrix.currentState: Special Abilities 1-15 upgrade probabilistically without safety checkpoints
gapsMatrix.externalEvidence: Soul Crystals have safe checkpoints at Lv 1, 6, 11, 16
gapsMatrix.observedGap: Risk of complete progress loss causes player aversion to SA upgrading
gapsMatrix.impact: Medium: discourages engagement with weapon socketing

gapsMatrix.currentState: Doll synthesis uses fixed RNG without bad-luck protection
gapsMatrix.externalEvidence: Dolls feature guaranteed compounding with cumulative failure points
gapsMatrix.observedGap: Bad luck streaks cause acute player frustration and waste duplicate dolls
gapsMatrix.impact: Medium: impairs satisfaction in a core collection system

gapsMatrix.currentState: Armor set bonuses require 5 pieces equipped; partial set gives 0 bonus
gapsMatrix.externalEvidence: Essence grants 3-piece partial bonuses and 5-piece full bonuses
gapsMatrix.observedGap: Players receive 0 benefit while holding 3 or 4 pieces of a set
gapsMatrix.impact: Medium: discourages gradual item equip during progression

adena.risk: Inflationary pressure from bulk gear sales to NPC

craftXp.risk: Accumulates without recipe variety to unlock
